LanguageData.LP_Tome_STR.label: manual of strength
LanguageData.LP_Tome_STR.description: A manual recording the ancient monks' methods of hardening the body. After 30 hours of study in total, the reader gets Strength +2 and Strength cap +2 (each ability can only be gained from a tome once), and the book then crumbles to ash.
LanguageData.LP_Tome_DEX.label: manual of dexterity
LanguageData.LP_Tome_DEX.description: A manual of footwork handed down through generations of the rogues' guild. After 30 hours of study in total, the reader gets Dexterity +2 and Dexterity cap +2 (each ability can only be gained from a tome once), and the book then crumbles to ash.
LanguageData.LP_Tome_CON.label: manual of constitution
LanguageData.LP_Tome_CON.description: An endurance manual dictated by a dwarven veteran and written down by an apprentice. After 30 hours of study in total, the reader gets Constitution +2 and Constitution cap +2 (each ability can only be gained from a tome once), and the book then crumbles to ash.
LanguageData.LP_Tome_INT.label: book of intelligence
